Class ParquetDataWriter

Namespace
ParquetNeo.Data
Assembly
ParquetNeo.dll

Writes the rows of an IDataReader (a database query, a DataTable through CreateDataReader(), or any other reader) as a Parquet file. Each column of the reader becomes a column of the file, typed by GetFieldType(int): the types of ColumnTypeRegistry, which are the ones ParquetSerializer writes. A column is optional unless the reader's schema table says AllowDBNull is false, and a decimal takes the precision and scale the schema table gives (38 and 18 otherwise).

Remarks

The rows go into row groups of RowGroupSize rows, each encoded and written to the stream when it is full, so memory is bounded by one row group whatever the size of the result. Only the current result set is written, and neither the reader nor the stream is closed.
